spans.s:
वोढव्य वोढव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. वह्),
to be borne or carried; able to be borne, &c.

वोढु, उस्, m. the son of a woman living in her
father's house (whose husband is absent).

वोढृ, ढा, ढ्री, ढृ, one who carries or bears
or draws, carrying, bearing, drawing; (ढा), m. a
bearer, porter; a leader, guide; a charioteer; a
draught-horse; a bull; a bridegroom; [cf. Lat.
vector.]
